namespace Contribution

open Matrix

/-! ## Periodic hypercubic lattice, link variables and gauge transformations -/

/-- Sites of the periodic hypercubic lattice `(ℤ/Lℤ)^d`. -/
abbrev Site (d L : ℕ) : Type := Fin d → ZMod L

/-- The lattice unit vector in direction `μ`. -/
def e {d L : ℕ} (μ : Fin d) : Site d L := Pi.single μ 1

/-- A lattice gauge field: one group element on each oriented link `(x, x + e μ)`. -/
abbrev LinkConfig (G : Type) (d L : ℕ) : Type := Site d L → Fin d → G

/-- A lattice gauge transformation: one group element per site. -/
abbrev GaugeTransform (G : Type) (d L : ℕ) : Type := Site d L → G

section General

variable {G : Type} [Group G] {d L : ℕ}

/-- The plaquette holonomy `U_{x,μ} U_{x+μ,ν} U_{x+ν,μ}⁻¹ U_{x,ν}⁻¹`. -/
def plaquette (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L) (μ ν : Fin d) : G :=
  U x μ * U (x + e μ) ν * (U (x + e ν) μ)⁻¹ * (U x ν)⁻¹

/-- Gauge action `U_{x,μ} ↦ g_x U_{x,μ} g_{x+μ}⁻¹`. -/
def gaugeAct (g : GaugeTransform G d L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) : LinkConfig G d L :=
  fun x μ => g x * U x μ * (g (x + e μ))⁻¹

/-- Plaquettes transform covariantly: by conjugation at their base point. -/
theorem plaquette_gaugeAct (g : GaugeTransform G d L) (U : LinkConfig G d L)
    (x : Site d L) (μ ν : Fin d) :
    plaquette (gaugeAct g U) x μ ν = g x * plaquette U x μ ν * (g x)⁻¹ := by
  simp only [plaquette, gaugeAct]
  rw [add_right_comm x (e ν) (e μ)]
  group

/-- Reversing the orientation of a plaquette inverts its holonomy. -/
theorem plaquette_swap (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L) (μ ν : Fin d) :
    plaquette U x ν μ = (plaquette U x μ ν)⁻¹ := by
  simp only [plaquette]
  group

theorem plaquette_self (U : LinkConfig G d L) (x : Site d L) (μ : Fin d) :
    plaquette U x μ μ = 1 := by
  simp only [plaquette]
  group

/-- A function on the gauge group invariant under conjugation. -/
def IsClassFunction (f : G → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ a b : G, f (a * b * a⁻¹) = f b

/-- The lattice action `∑_x ∑_{μ<ν} f(U_p)` with plaquette weight `f`. -/
def latticeAction [NeZero L] (f : G → ℝ) (U : LinkConfig G d L) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x : Site d L, ∑ μ : Fin d, ∑ ν : Fin d, if μ < ν then f (plaquette U x μ ν) else 0

/-- Any lattice action built from a class function is gauge invariant. -/
theorem latticeAction_gaugeAct [NeZero L] (f : G → ℝ) (hf : IsClassFunction f)
    (g : GaugeTransform G d L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    latticeAction f (gaugeAct g U) = latticeAction f U := by
  have hf' : ∀ a b : G, f (a * b * a⁻¹) = f b := hf
  simp only [latticeAction, plaquette_gaugeAct, hf']

end General

/-! ## The Wilson plaquette weight on `U(n)` -/

section Wilson

variable {n : ℕ}

/-- The Wilson plaquette weight `n - Re tr M`. -/
noncomputable def wilsonWeight (n : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (n : ℝ) - (trace M).re

/-- Squared Frobenius distance `‖M - 1‖²` of a matrix to the identity. -/
noncomputable def frobDistSq (n : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, Complex.normSq ((M - 1) j i)

/-- For unitary `M`, the Wilson weight equals half the squared Frobenius distance to `1`. -/
theorem two_mul_wilsonWeight {M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hM : M ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin n) ℂ) : 2 * wilsonWeight n M = frobDistSq n M := by
  have hU : star M * M = 1 := (mem_unitaryGroup_iff').mp hM
  have key : star (M - 1) * (M - 1) = (1 + 1) - star M - M := by
    rw [star_sub, star_one]
    have : (star M - 1) * (M - 1) = star M * M - star M - M + 1 := by noncomm_ring
    rw [this, hU]
    abel
  have hentry : ∀ A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ,
      trace (star A * A) = ∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, (Complex.normSq (A j i) : ℂ) := by
    intro A
    simp only [trace, diag, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.star_apply, Complex.star_def,
      Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self]
  have h := congrArg Complex.re ((hentry (M - 1)).symm.trans (congrArg trace key))
  simp only [Complex.re_sum, Complex.ofReal_re, trace_sub, trace_add, trace_one,
    Fintype.card_fin, Complex.sub_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.natCast_re] at h
  rw [star_eq_conjTranspose, trace_conjTranspose, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_re] at h
  rw [frobDistSq, h, wilsonWeight]
  ring

theorem frobDistSq_nonneg (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : 0 ≤ frobDistSq n M :=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _

theorem wilsonWeight_nonneg {M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hM : M ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin n) ℂ) : 0 ≤ wilsonWeight n M := by
  have h := two_mul_wilsonWeight hM
  have := frobDistSq_nonneg (n := n) M
  linarith

theorem wilsonWeight_eq_zero_iff {M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ}
    (hM : M ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin n) ℂ) : wilsonWeight n M = 0 ↔ M = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h0
    have h := two_mul_wilsonWeight hM
    rw [h0, mul_zero, eq_comm, frobDistSq,
      Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun i _ =>
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _] at h
    ext j i
    have hi := h i (Finset.mem_univ _)
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun j _ => Complex.normSq_nonneg _] at hi
    have hji := Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp (hi j (Finset.mem_univ _))
    rw [Matrix.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] at hji
    exact hji
  · rintro rfl
    simp [wilsonWeight, trace_one]

/-- Conjugation by a unitary matrix preserves the Wilson weight. -/
theorem wilsonWeight_conj {A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hA : A ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin n) ℂ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : wilsonWeight n (A * M * star A) = wilsonWeight n M := by
  have ha : star A * A = 1 := (mem_unitaryGroup_iff').mp hA
  simp only [wilsonWeight]
  rw [trace_mul_comm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, ha, Matrix.one_mul]

/-! ### Wilson action for any gauge group with a unitary representation -/

variable {G : Type} [Group G]

/-- `ρ : G → M_n(ℂ)` is a unitary representation: unitary-valued and multiplicative. -/
def IsUnitaryRep (ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) : Prop :=
  (∀ g : G, ρ g ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin n) ℂ) ∧ ∀ a b : G, ρ (a * b) = ρ a * ρ b

/-- The Wilson action `S_ρ(U) = ∑_x ∑_{μ<ν} (n - Re tr ρ(U_p))`. -/
noncomputable def wilsonAction {d L : ℕ} [NeZero L] (ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) : ℝ :=
  latticeAction (fun g => wilsonWeight n (ρ g)) U

/-- Every plaquette holonomy is the identity. -/
def IsFlat {d L : ℕ} (U : LinkConfig G d L) : Prop := ∀ x μ ν, plaquette U x μ ν = 1

/-- Every plaquette holonomy lies in the kernel of `ρ`. -/
def PlaquettesInKer {d L : ℕ} (ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ x μ ν, ρ (plaquette U x μ ν) = 1

/-- The representation packaged as a homomorphism into `U(n)`. -/
def IsUnitaryRep.hom {ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hρ : IsUnitaryRep ρ) :
    G →* unitaryGroup (Fin n) ℂ :=
  MonoidHom.mk' (fun g => ⟨ρ g, hρ.1 g⟩) fun a b => Subtype.ext (hρ.2 a b)

theorem IsUnitaryRep.hom_val {ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hρ : IsUnitaryRep ρ)
    (g : G) : (hρ.hom g).1 = ρ g := rfl

theorem IsUnitaryRep.map_one {ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hρ : IsUnitaryRep ρ) :
    ρ 1 = 1 := by
  rw [← hρ.hom_val, _root_.map_one]; rfl

theorem IsUnitaryRep.map_inv {ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ} (hρ : IsUnitaryRep ρ)
    (g : G) : ρ g⁻¹ = star (ρ g) := by
  rw [← hρ.hom_val, _root_.map_inv]; rfl

theorem wilsonAction_gaugeAct {d L : ℕ} [NeZero L] (ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hρ : IsUnitaryRep ρ) (g : GaugeTransform G d L) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    wilsonAction ρ (gaugeAct g U) = wilsonAction ρ U := by
  apply latticeAction_gaugeAct
  intro a b
  simp only [hρ.2, hρ.map_inv]
  exact wilsonWeight_conj (hρ.1 a) (ρ b)

theorem wilsonAction_nonneg {d L : ℕ} [NeZero L] (ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hρ : IsUnitaryRep ρ) (U : LinkConfig G d L) : 0 ≤ wilsonAction ρ U := by
  unfold wilsonAction latticeAction
  refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun x _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun μ _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun ν _ => ?_
  split_ifs
  · exact wilsonWeight_nonneg (hρ.1 _)
  · exact le_rfl

/-- The Wilson action vanishes exactly when every plaquette lies in `ker ρ`. -/
theorem wilsonAction_eq_zero_iff {d L : ℕ} [NeZero L] (ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hρ : IsUnitaryRep ρ) (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    wilsonAction ρ U = 0 ↔ PlaquettesInKer ρ U := by
  have hnn : ∀ x μ ν,
      0 ≤ (if μ < ν then wilsonWeight n (ρ (plaquette U x μ ν)) else 0) := by
    intro x μ ν
    split_ifs
    · exact wilsonWeight_nonneg (hρ.1 _)
    · exact le_rfl
  unfold wilsonAction latticeAction PlaquettesInKer
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun x _ =>
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun μ _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun ν _ => hnn x μ ν]
  constructor
  · intro h x μ ν
    have hx := h x (Finset.mem_univ _)
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun μ _ =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun ν _ => hnn x μ ν] at hx
    have hlt : ∀ μ ν : Fin d, μ < ν → ρ (plaquette U x μ ν) = 1 := by
      intro μ ν hμν
      have hμ := hx μ (Finset.mem_univ _)
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun ν _ => hnn x μ ν] at hμ
      have hν := hμ ν (Finset.mem_univ _)
      simp only [hμν, ↓reduceIte] at hν
      exact (wilsonWeight_eq_zero_iff (hρ.1 _)).mp hν
    rcases lt_trichotomy μ ν with hμν | rfl | hνμ
    · exact hlt μ ν hμν
    · rw [plaquette_self, hρ.map_one]
    · rw [plaquette_swap, hρ.map_inv, hlt ν μ hνμ, star_one]
  · intro h x _
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun μ _ => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ν _ => ?_
    split_ifs
    · exact (wilsonWeight_eq_zero_iff (hρ.1 _)).mpr (h x μ ν)
    · rfl

/-- For a faithful representation the classical vacua are exactly the flat configurations. -/
theorem wilsonAction_eq_zero_iff_flat {d L : ℕ} [NeZero L]
    (ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hρ : IsUnitaryRep ρ) (hinj : Function.Injective ρ)
    (U : LinkConfig G d L) :
    wilsonAction ρ U = 0 ↔ IsFlat U := by
  rw [wilsonAction_eq_zero_iff ρ hρ, PlaquettesInKer, IsFlat]
  have key : ∀ p : G, ρ p = 1 ↔ p = 1 := fun p =>
    ⟨fun h => hinj (h.trans hρ.map_one.symm), fun h => h ▸ hρ.map_one⟩
  simp only [key]

end Wilson

/-- Foundations of lattice Yang–Mills on the periodic lattice `(ℤ/Lℤ)^d`:
(1) every class-function plaquette action is gauge invariant, for any gauge group;
(2) for a gauge group `G` with a unitary representation `ρ : G → U(n)`, the Wilson action
`∑_x ∑_{μ<ν} (n - Re tr ρ(U_p))` is gauge invariant and nonnegative, and it vanishes exactly
when every plaquette lies in `ker ρ`; for faithful `ρ`, exactly on flat configurations;
(3) on `U(n)` the Wilson weight equals half the squared Frobenius distance `‖M - 1‖²`. -/
theorem result :
    (∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (f : G → ℝ), IsClassFunction f →
      ∀ (g : GaugeTransform G d L) (U : LinkConfig G d L),
        latticeAction f (gaugeAct g U) = latticeAction f U) ∧
    (∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (n d L : ℕ) [NeZero L] (ρ : G → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ),
      IsUnitaryRep ρ → ∀ U : LinkConfig G d L,
        (∀ g : GaugeTransform G d L, wilsonAction ρ (gaugeAct g U) = wilsonAction ρ U) ∧
        0 ≤ wilsonAction ρ U ∧
        (wilsonAction ρ U = 0 ↔ PlaquettesInKer ρ U) ∧
        (Function.Injective ρ → (wilsonAction ρ U = 0 ↔ IsFlat U))) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ), M ∈ unitaryGroup (Fin n) ℂ →
      2 * wilsonWeight n M = frobDistSq n M) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro G _ d L _ f hf g U
    exact latticeAction_gaugeAct f hf g U
  · intro G _ n d L _ ρ hρ U
    exact ⟨fun g => wilsonAction_gaugeAct ρ hρ g U, wilsonAction_nonneg ρ hρ U,
      wilsonAction_eq_zero_iff ρ hρ U, fun hinj => wilsonAction_eq_zero_iff_flat ρ hρ hinj U⟩
  · intro n M hM
    exact two_mul_wilsonWeight hM

end Contribution
